facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2023-0034 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 12 February 2023 as a scheduled change under change assurance; no event precedes it in the record. The change assurance record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
